ModuleDescription: Complete Virtual Desktop face reader with independent Quest Pro gaze and an opt-in fail-safe experimental tongue override.
UsageInstructions: Install an independent-eye Magisk module on the headset yourself for independent gaze (the QproFaceTracking hub detects it; see First-time setup step 3), and use build-and-run.ps1 -TonguePreview for opt-in tongue output.
